starting_point: Python and either DevOps/software delivery experience or familiarity with a trained ML model. This plan develops an existing foundation.

phase_1.label: Make a model reproducible
phase_1.slide: Version code, data references and experiment results
actions: Start with one small scikit-learn model and synthetic data. Pin dependencies and record data-generation settings.
Track parameters, evaluation results and model files for two runs.
phase_1.output: A repeatable training command and an experiment comparison.

phase_2.label: Create a controlled release
phase_2.slide: Automated tests and one local serving path
actions: Wrap inference in a batch command or simple local API and validate input schemas.
Add an automated quality check that prevents promotion of a failing model and retain the previous model version.
phase_2.output: A tested local delivery pipeline with an explicit model approval rule.

phase_3.label: Operate and recover
phase_3.slide: Monitor inputs and rehearse a rollback
actions: Log requests, latency or batch duration and data-quality failures. Simulate changed input data and inspect the signal.
Demonstrate rollback, explain why drift alone does not prove degraded model quality, and write an incident runbook.
phase_3.output: A small model service with monitoring evidence, release history and recovery instructions.

portfolio: A versioned model delivery pipeline with validation, operational monitoring and rollback.
tools: Python, scikit-learn, local MLflow or a simple structured experiment log, Git and local tests. Containers are optional.
acceptance: A documented command reproduces a model and its evaluation from the recorded code and data settings.
A deliberately failing release cannot pass the automated promotion check.
A simulated bad release can be rolled back, with input/output checks and recovery time recorded.
first_step: Choose one existing small model and list everything required to reproduce it.
beginner_adjustment: Learn Python, Git and basic model evaluation first. Kubernetes and a feature store are optional later work.
